## Source: amazon-inspector (557501a2edb08de76291f677e401099313fc5537144900a38497951379218ecd)
The npm package ep_nxs74552 is an Etherpad plugin that registers an expressPreSession hook mounting an unauthenticated GET route at /Nx_74552/ on the Etherpad server. Any remote visitor to that URL receives a JSON response containing os.hostname(), os.userInfo().username, os.platform(), process.version, process.cwd() and process.pid, together with a 'Nxploited | Nx-zD' branding string. The route is not part of any advertised plugin functionality and is not gated by Etherpad's authentication; installing the plugin silently adds a hidden reconnaissance endpoint on the installer's server that leaks host and account identity to the public internet.
